zh-CN.title: 更自在的主角登场
items: 登场冷却改为每人每会话独立 3 分钟，冷却中不展示手动按键并提示静默进入
个性化中统一通过主角按键设置成员音效自动播放、登场方式和自动选曲

en.title: More flexible entrances
items: Independent 3-minute cooldowns per user and conversation, with silent-entry notices and no unavailable manual keys
One personalization entry for member autoplay, entrance mode and automatic track selection
